summary: Remote-controlled interactive shell driven by WebSocket peer
details: On startup the package connects to a configured WebSocket server and processes server-originated messages that spawn and drive an interactive shell on the host. handleTerminalCreate spawns a PTY via node-pty (bash/pwsh/cmd) and handleTerminalInput writes the server-supplied msg.data directly into term.pty.write(...), giving the remote WebSocket peer a full interactive shell on the installer's machine. Additional server-dispatched handlers perform file mutations and git operations under the same message channel. At startup the agent also clones https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git from a mutable branch (no commit pin, no hash verification) into ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/ and chmods files under hooks/ to 0755, so remotely-fetched hook scripts become executable in the Claude CLI plugin path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
